clips.title: The story
paras: Iron Rivets are sturdy construction fasteners manufactured in Stormwind to help rebuild the ruined Everstill Bridge in Lakeshire. After a supply caravan was ambushed and looted by Redridge gnolls, these heavy metal components ended up scattered across the gnoll camps in the northern hills.

When Lakeshire faced repeated assaults from the Blackrock orcs, the town council was forced to melt down their structural iron reserves to forge urgent weapons, armor, and munitions. Once the immediate crisis subsided, Foreman Oslow requested fresh building supplies from Stormwind to mend the fractured Everstill Bridge. However, the supply caravan ferrying the shipment was ambushed by local Redridge gnolls before reaching the town. The pack beasts and wagons were dragged into the hills north of Lake Everstill, scattering essential construction materials like iron rivets and pikes among the gnoll packs.

Without these heavy iron rivets, structural repairs on the Everstill Bridge cannot proceed safely. The stone and timber framework spanning the lake requires reinforced metal fasteners to withstand the weight of carts and travelers. Recovering the rivets directly from the gnoll camps is essential for restoring Lakeshire's vital link to the western valleys and securing the town's perimeter against further incursions.
